Auto level-up

Runs while automation is on, in hunting and campaign. Each level uses earned XP only. No platinum or XP tokens are spent. Selected-copy training below caps slots 2-4 at level 30 and works even when this general training toggle is off.

YOUR ACCOUNT RECORD

Arena win totals

Sign in to load your current arena record.

Account totals come from the game server and remain separate from this run. Battle Arena shows weekly wins; Random Arena shows monthly wins. Platinum shows lifetime wins only when supplied by the server, plus current/best streak.

FIND YOUR OPPONENT

Auto arena battle

Save, then press Start automation while on this tab. Uses your current team and HP. Team training/replacement and wild healing are suspended during arena runs. No automatic platinum heal or item purchases. Opponents and outcomes follow the game server.

CURRENT RUN

Arena status

Idle

Choose an arena and sign in to start.

Pause cancels an outstanding queue. If a match was already assigned, it is restored for manual play. Default/Platinum follow the native 91-second bot fallback; matchmaking stops after 120 seconds. Random Arena first bans 6 species, then picks 4 from the server pool.

RANDOM ARENA

Draft

While running, automation ranks abilities and stat profiles; picks also balance element coverage. Pause to choose manually; the server timer keeps running. This is a basic strategy and does not guarantee a win.

Wild-hunt healing

0 virtue used

Counter reset and profile changes do not reset budget usage. A fresh sign-in starts a new budget. Campaign keeps its existing two-fainted rule. No platinum heal.

REUSABLE SETUPS

Hunt profiles

Profiles store hunt, team and healing preferences only. Loading saves those settings and requires automation paused. It never starts a run. Up to 20 profiles; saving an existing name replaces it.

THIS SIGN-IN SESSION

Session statistics

Searches count submitted search requests. Captures count confirmed keeps; duplicates mean an already-owned family. XP is the server-awarded team XP in battle summaries. Elapsed time includes pauses. Stats reset on sign-in/backend restart; healing budget usage does not reset with these counters.
